en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I promised to meet up with Himiko.
I'll head to the dojo.

<CLT=cltMIND>The reason Gonta said he wanted to
fight Monokuma was to save his friends...
<CLT=cltMIND>I think...Miu is the same.
<CLT=cltMIND>What about me?

<CLT=cltMIND>My friends die...and all I can do is
solve their murder after it's over.
There has to be something more I can do...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to rest in bed?
Free Time will end if you do.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's still some time...
I should take a quick rest.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>They went through all this just for a
killing game? What is their objective...?
